name: goal-build
description: [skills] [hooks] Takes approved requirements to a PR-ready branch and stops before the PR: design writes SPEC.md and batches questions per step, implement runs test-first under /goal with a read-only spec-reviewer subagent (at most two review rounds), report writes REPORT.md and a PR body. Hooks block gh pr create / merge and edits to the approved SPEC.md, keep Claude working until the repo's checks pass, and act only while a flow is active
